performance: DiagnosticPerformance inherits native PerfBase unchanged: diagnostic kinematics, no aircraft envelope clipping
reconstruction_choices: No learned control. B744 is only an identifier under DiagnosticPerformance. Not the paper's 12 UAV types. Fixed seed rotates deliberately crossing diagnostic routes, not a training or evaluation population. Arrival uses endpoint radius. Exposure uses left-endpoint sampling and spherical great-circle distance.
